svg.title: Separate restart ensembles from records within a state
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Separate restart ensembles from records within a state
Equal-probability restart states: a = 0.03 rad, within-state SD = 0.01 rad
Random-constant errors: each record retains its own mean
Both models: ensemble mean 0, marginal SD 0.02 rad; traces do not prove ergodicity.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
